Default owns Full diagnostics plus persistent dispatchers/pointer/timer/text/request states. summary only changes diagnostics. Getter borrows are scoped; mutable pointer access requires coordination with Surface capture. Tooltip arming clears prior transient candidate/timers then duplicates ID into independent Surface/timer owners; drains transfer ownership.

Ordinary dispatch synchronizes text owner and snapshots physical pointer facts before mutable touch semantics, tooltip clearing and release click-count preparation. Fallible Surface call follows those changes; no blanket rollback. Success alone arms click candidate, updates table, arms delivered component timers and records text/IME/clipboard lifecycles. Window branch delegates its own lifecycle path without ordinary pointer-table postprocessing. Batch exits on first Err, preserves earlier effects and drops local result vector; outcome is constructed only on all-success.

tick records time, expires click/intro state, drains typeahead/submenu/tooltip/toast in order and dispatches sequence0 events before deferred focus lifecycle. Actual current Surface dispatch Timer branches return ordinary results with infallible convergence, so no invented mid-timer Err/lost-queue defect. Focus lifecycle receipt is synthetic IME Cancel with delivered component reports; queues own outputs until drained.

Undelivered component reports are ignored for arming. KeyboardText uses authored timeout; hovered_option_id replaces/removes submenu timer. Tooltip Hover and Surface candidate change together. Toast queue parser borrows event ID; invalid queue falls back to Surface state, selected property changes/OpenPopup resample state and ClosePopup clears timer. Input activity kinds exclude timer/popup and dismiss tooltip before dispatch.

Primary release must still hit previously pressed node before double-click count is max-merged; candidate stored only after success. Physical pointer snapshot retains button/source/identity even when secondary touch button is suppressed. Cancel removes pointer entry; all other events use actual pointer_routing for physical hover, routed press and capture, independent of diagnostics. Existing primary entry wins; new touch-like source checks source counter. Owner-filtered tooltip clearing preserves other owners. Timestamp match exhaustively borrows all input variants.

Array uses first valid nested value; map first nonempty string/enum ID and first convertible duration then positive filter. String splits pipe, trims ID/fields, skips unknown fields, but first recognized invalid/zero duration returns None. Int negatives clamp0; Float round().max(0) as u64; string parses u64. Borrowed &str lasts with original UiValue, timer storage owns only when needed. No blanket format validation or arbitrary allocation claim.

Only inline_len prefix is valid; node0 sentinel is not a member. Duplicates return false, first16 stay inline,17th migrates all16 into HashSet using max(expected_len,17) capacity then inserts. Expected length is not a limit. Pointer preview runs separately before the shared target/bubble visited set; navigation deduplicates one selected candidate list. Two tests only prove current shallow and promoted cases, not arbitrary traversal or exact allocator behavior.

Manager10 tests validate timers and Surface candidates using authored fixtures/delivered reports; parser3 cover pointer identity/source probes; routing3 cover policy order/text probes and fixed capacity timing; outcome3+4 cover behavior/text probes and sparse/dense timing; visited2 cover inline/promotion. Single-pass bench21 alternating pairs*2048 batches*256 results uses one request at tail and asserts95th<=70%; capacity bench17*1024*4096 uses first request and models growth events without allocator sampling; route bench17*2M compares Vec strategies, not full event dispatch.
